mapper.update: CREATE TABLE if not exists account( id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT, password VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL comment "BCyrpt加密", email VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL UNIQUE, status TINYINT NOT NULL, create_time DATETIME NOT NULL, update_time DATETIME NOT NULL, latest_login_time DATETIME );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS user( user_id INT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, gender TINYINT, nick_name VARCHAR(50), description VARCHAR(100), avatar_url VARCHAR(100), vita_url VARCHAR(100), vita_content VARCHAR(2000), );
